resolution: Evaluation complete; the candidate is rejected. r.TAA.ReconstructionHdrWeightExponent (default 1.0) failed G1, G2, G6 and G7 against gates frozen before it existed, and it stays opt-in (ledger H-21..H-23). G7 fails through its G6 clause. Its lighting-path clause rests on one capture per variant: materials.json predates the layout-bug window that the ledger's audit listed it under (H-23c). The TAA resolve and upscaler are unchanged since 7eea6b95. scripts/rendering/test_correction_gates.py ran to completion 10/10 and 11/11 on 2026-09-09, after development revisions at 8/10 and 9/10. It ran 11/11 on 2026-09-10 after the layout-bug fix, 10/11 on 2026-09-16 and 11/11 on 2026-09-21. The 2026-09-16 failure was the omitted-vs-1.0 control judged against a single-pair floor. It was re-tested in 40-default-vs-explicit with 4 interleaved repeats per condition and read INDISTINGUISHABLE on both max and mean. Run manifests now record argv and cvar_overrides (runtime/tools/uzengine.cpp, 7eea6b95). On 2026-10-08 the harness was changed to capture 4 interleaved repeats per configuration. It now judges omitted vs 1.0, exponent 0 vs ReconstructionMode=1 and the TAA-off control by max(between) <= max(within) on max |delta|. It was verified statically on the 40-default-vs-explicit captures: 35 of 35 null splits pass, against 89.5 % of pair choices for the old single-pair rule. Its GPU run is recorded in notes.md, 'Close-out (2026-10-08)'. followup-09, -10, -12 and -13 had routed the stale gtests PerFrameCB_Is768Bytes and PrefilteredMipLevelsDefaultIsFive to item 1.6. Both were fixed on 2026-10-08 in 8246ab5c: the size test was removed as a duplicate of the 1024-byte pins, the mip test was renamed PrefilteredMipLevelsDefaultMatchesTheBaker, and the commit records 47/47 on its filter. The records were corrected in place on 2026-10-08: tasks.md 1.1, 1.3-1.6, 2.2 and 2.3, design.md and notes.md. The AABB-only clamp rejection rests on one motion run per variant plus a static G1 shortfall (ledger H-23b). The evidence packages under .screenshots/ are git-ignored and local only. The visual defect is not closed. The window's static residual is tracked in docs/analysis/known-issues-and-partial-implementations.md, 'Static TAA residual', and is owned by the task proposed at close-out (phase0_sponza-followup-15-taa-window-residual). The rear door and the walls belong to followup-12 and motion to followup-13, or to the successors their own close-outs name.
